items.actClause: AN ACT to authorize the village of Ossining to convey an easement and temporarily alienate parkland for the purposes of completing and operating certain proposed improvements to a sanitary sewer pipeline in Snowden Park
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:S5655

TITLE OF BILL:  An act to authorize the village of Ossining to convey
an easement and temporarily alienate parkland for the purposes of
completing and operating certain proposed improvements to a sanitary
sewer pipeline in Snowden Park

PURPOSE:  To authorize the Village of Ossining to convey an easement
and temporarily alienate parkland for the purposes of completing and
operating certain proposed improvements to a sanitary sewer pipeline.

SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:

Section 1. The village of Ossining, in the county of Westchester, is
authorized to convey by appropriate instruments to the county of
Westchester, a permanent easement for the purpose of enabling such
county to re-route and operate a sanitary sewer pipeline under village
parkland described as parcel A in section 3 of this act. Such village
is also authorized to temporarily alienate a portion of village
parkland described as parcel B in section three of this act for
construction purposes. Upon completion of construction to re-route
such sanitary sewer pipeline the village of Ossining shall ensure that
the surface of the lands are restored such that the lands shall
continue to be used for park purposes, and there shall be no net loss
of village parkland

Section 2. The authorization shall be effective only upon the
condition that an amount equal to or greater than the fair market
value of the interests being conveyed and temporarily alienated
pursuant to section one of this act is dedicated for the acquisition
of new village parklands and/or for capital improvements to existing
village park and recreational facilities.

Section 3 describes the metes and bounds for Parcel A and B.

Section 4. If the parkland that is the subject of this act has
received funding pursuant to the federal land and water conservation
fund, the discontinuance of parkland authorized by the provisions of
this act shall not occur until the municipality has complied with the
federal requirements pertaining to the conversion of parklands,
including satisfying the secretary of interior that the discontinuance
with all conditions which the secretary of the interior deems
necessary to assure the substitution of other lands shall be
equivalent in fair market value and recreational usefulness to the
lands being discontinued.

Section 5 sets the effective date.

JUSTIFICATION:  This legislation authorizes the conveyance of an
easement and temporarily alienates parkland for the purposes of
completing and operating certain proposed improvements to a sanitary
sewer pipeline in Snowden Park, a Village of Ossining park. It would
provide the Village with the ability to convey a permanent easement
under a portion of Snowden Park to Westchester County for utility
purposes, and a temporary easement to facilitate construction of same.
A children's playground will be removed from one part of the park to


another. A new playground will be installed by the county of
Westchester.

LEGISLATIVE HISTORY: New bill.

FISCAL IMPLICATIONS: None.

EFFECTIVE DATE:  This act shall take effect immediately.

Section 5 sets the effective date.

JUSTIFICATION:

This legislation authorizes the conveyance of an easement and

Village with the ability to convey a permanent easement under a


portion of Snowden Park to Westchester County for utility purposes,

New bill.

None.

EFFECTIVE DATE:

This act shall take effect immediately.
